Description
Oxford International English Schools offer English language courses for adults in six locations across the United Kingdom, USA and Canada. Our schools provide students with fantastic and academically strong English language programmes in six amazing cities; Brighton, London Greenwich, Oxford, San Diego, Toronto and Vancouver. Each of the schools is open all year-round, offer modern facilities and are equipped with state-of-the-art learning facilities. All courses are led by a team of experienced and qualified teachers, and students also benefit from a very active weekly social programme run by an enthusiastic team of activity leaders.
